Implement and benchmark V3 ONLY: exactly the V2 endpoint-second cost, SLO-based admission, security gain V, and deterministic greedy selection, PLUS the NEW adaptive lambda controller affecting J=V-lambda_eff*E. Do not implement entropy, history-aware picker, stochastic timing or priced-worth rejection. This is an isolated experimental patch, not a production deployment. Keep the original behavior accessible as baseline and preserve the runner's automatic restoration.

FIRST INSPECT THE REAL REPOSITORY. Locate the existing candidate generation, security gain/provenance/fact invalidation, action registry, economics.go, decision selection, readiness/EndpointSlice data, SLO configuration, move history, budget journal and replay tests. Use existing types/APIs; do not invent names or claim that proposed features already exist. Record file paths and which data actually exist. Do not implement fake stubs that silently return success. If a mandatory input is missing, report BLOCKED with the exact missing field/path; do not replace it with invented measurements.

V3 SECURITY GAIN (IDENTICAL TO V2): For each feasible candidate m, calculate V(m) as the EXISTING incremental, provenance-adjusted weighted coverage of facts actually invalidatable by that action in the current snapshot, with any old cost penalty removed. Deduplicate fact identities across pods/actions before summing. An action that cannot invalidate a fact contributes zero for that fact. Do not assume rotate invalidates every kind of fact. Use the actual existing fact-to-actuator mapping and provenance evidence; do not manufacture q,d or verification data. If a new verified-effect matrix is not present, retain the existing grounded coverage/provenance semantics, explicitly report the limitation, and do not claim verified 24-hour coverage. V must be in security points, not endpoint-seconds.

V3 BUDGET (IDENTICAL TO V2): Per workload use R=(1-s)*W*N endpoint-seconds, where N is workload spec.replicas (NOT currently ready pods), s is accepted policy SLO (study default .999), and W is accepted policy window (study default 30 days = 2592000 seconds). In acting mode, missing accepted SLO refuses hygiene/response; do not silently treat a default as tenant acceptance. Used = deduplicated settled measured endpoint-seconds in the rolling W window; held = reservations for open moves, with overdue holds at least actual measured loss so far. R_left=R-used-held. Admission requires rho<=R_left (or rho=0). Atomic reservations and open-to-settled transfer must not double-charge. If the authoritative ledger is absent, implement a truthful shadow estimator and report that acting admission is BLOCKED; do not invent settled charges.

V3 COST (IDENTICAL TO V2): k is number of served endpoints actually taken out of service by candidate; quarantine k=1 even when unserved, unless workload has no endpoints (then k=0). Partition duration samples by workload UID and action; newest 200 settled within W, excluding suspect lineage; censored samples must be retained. Class prior T_class: GPU-serving 130s; stateful (StatefulSet/PVC) 141s; stateless Deployment/ReplicaSet without GPU/PVC 43s; unknown 400s. For n<29, T_mid=T_class and T_upper=max(T_class, largest finite sample); any censored sample makes upper bound unavailable. For n>=29, T_mid=median of usable observed durations and T_upper is the r-th order statistic with censored durations sorted as +infinity, where r is the smallest integer satisfying P[Binomial(n,0.9)<r]>=0.95. If the selected r-th duration is censored/infinite, mark BOUND_MISSING. Do not replace missing bounds with arbitrary numbers. Set D=T_upper, T_rb=T_upper (explicit study proxy, NOT measured rollback), H_tail=k*T_upper, watchdog delta=30s. Let x be overdue moves out of n; p_f=1 for n=0 or x=n, otherwise the upper 95% Clopper-Pearson beta quantile BetaInv(.95,x+1,n-x), computed with a tested numeric implementation (no made-up constant). Compute rho=k*(D+delta+T_rb)+H_tail; C_flow=k*T_mid; C_norm=p_f*(k*(D-T_mid+delta+T_rb)+H_tail); E=C_flow+C_norm. All quantities are endpoint-seconds. E is the ranking cost estimate, rho is the hard admission reservation; never substitute E for rho. For k=0, preserve documented zero-endpoint behavior. If exact duration/history information is unavailable, label candidate BOUND_MISSING rather than inventing samples.

ACTION-SPECIFIC RULES: rotate and request-drain use standard formulas. Quarantine has H_eff=min(cap,R_left-delta-3*T_rot), D=H_eff+T_rot, T_rb=T_rot, H_tail=T_rot, T_mid=H_eff+T_midrot, rho=H_eff+delta+3*T_rot; refuse BUDGET when H_eff<=0 and BOUND_MISSING if rotate bound absent. kv-reset: k=1 if served; measured charge is zero when it stays served, but DO NOT assume a zero cold-start reservation or invent an unapproved kv-reset prior. Preserve singleton/last-endpoint hygiene refusal and report the known kv-reset limitation. Other actuator classes must use documented bounds or remain unsupported/BLOCKED; never pretend all actions are rotate.

GATES AND PRIORITY: Retain binding/installability, open-move, PDB, capacity, worth, one-move-per-pod, max B=1, singleton/last-endpoint, quorum, bound and budget checks, and state recheck. Deterministic urgent containment comes before optional hygiene; never price or randomize containment. Do not silently implement unapproved C1-C5 containment fixes. If containment cannot be admitted, preserve/refine NO_SAFE_CONTAINMENT_ACTION reporting without bypassing gates. No 24-hour coverage guarantee or new scheduling/anti-neglect controller in V2; those require separate validated implementations.

GREEDY: Among optional candidates that pass ALL hard gates, choose maximum finite J; for equal J prefer higher V, then lower E, then stable candidate ID. At lambda_eff=0 this must reproduce V2 selection and tie-breaking. V3 objective is J=V-lambda_eff*E; compare J, not V, after feasibility gates. Containment is selected deterministically before optional pricing. Preserve existing deterministic priority and NOOP/refusal behavior; do not allow low E to override higher V. Remove the old 1.2 ceiling, C_Hi, old 0.4/0.6 norm/flow penalty, old beta/dual move-count lambda ONLY from the new V3 path; do not delete the legacy baseline path. Avoid adding new production behavior by default: put V3 behind an experimental flag, enabled only for its isolated benchmark arm. V3 must not alter production or actuate without separate authorization.

NEW LAMBDA CONTROLLER (DO NOT REUSE LEGACY dual.go): One lambda per (workload UID, policy). Update once per policy tick from an atomic snapshot, using trusted endpoint loss, NOT reserved rho, expected E, move count, pod self-reported request rate or forecast spending. Define L=86400 seconds (study candidate, one day), W=accepted SLO window seconds, R=(1-s)*W*spec.replicas endpoint-seconds. S(t)=sum of deduplicated measured endpoint-seconds from settled moves in [t-L,t], PLUS accrued measured endpoint-seconds on open moves during that lookback. When a move settles, replace its open contribution with the settled contribution for the same underlying time intervals, never count both. Exclude containment from S only (study choice); containment still counts in authoritative R used/held. If attribution of unready intervals to an actual move is missing, do not treat arbitrary pod readiness loss as trusted move spend; report missing telemetry and keep lambda inactive rather than guessing.

Compute b=S*W/(L*R); g=max(-1,min(b-1,G_max)); lambda_next=clamp(lambda_prev*exp(eta*dt*g),lambda_min,lambda_max). Study-only candidates: G_max=1, lambda_min=0.0001, lambda_max=1000, eta=ln(lambda_max/lambda_min)/3600 per second, dt=clamp(snapshot_time-last_update,0,30 seconds), lambda_0=lambda_min. At exactly lambda_min, lambda_eff=0. These numerical values are NOT approved production calibration. Handle NaN/Inf, missing R, backwards clocks, duplicate ticks, restart, and failed durable state writes by disabling the cost term and reporting the exact reason; do not silently substitute fabricated spend or timestamps. Record lambda_prev, lambda_next, b, g, dt, S, R, and state-write outcome. Update and score from one coherent snapshot; replay with recorded timestamps.

PRICE SCALING: The study candidates above are SCALED lambda_s values measured in security points. For this benchmark use J=V-lambda_s*(E/R), equivalently J=V-lambda_eff*E with lambda_eff=lambda_s/R (security points per endpoint-second). R is the SAME accepted workload SLO budget used by admission. This is an explicit study-form choice for V3, not an approved production pricing decision. Do not insert lambda_s directly into V-lambda_s*E, because that mixes units and changes the experiment by a factor of R. For invalid/nonpositive R, no pricing and refuse moves under the normal budget gates. If E=0, its price is zero. For unavailable/nonfinite E, apply the existing BOUND_MISSING/refusal rule, not an artificial zero price. No lambda penalty for containment. Do not apply a priced-worth gate (theta2): retain V2's v>theta rule. Lambda changes only optional greedy ordering, never admission or mandatory containment. If lambda remains at floor and no decisions change, report the true zero effect; do not force lambda upward to manufacture differences.

COMPARISON CONTRACT: This single benchmark job must contain a self-contained V2 reference arm (new cost, V-only greedy, lambda=0) and V3 arm (IDENTICAL cost, gates, V, candidate set, tie rules and greedy, lambda enabled). Include untouched legacy only as an optional diagnostic reference. Both V2 and V3 must use identical snapshots and independently initialized state. V3 lambda state evolves only from trustworthy measured evidence, never from counterfactual actions that the shadow arm did not actually execute. On a fixed recorded trace, replayed spend is shared exogenous evidence; selected-but-not-executed actions have unknown future cost and verified effects. If V2 code is absent because earlier benchmark patches were reverted, implement V2 and V3 together in this ONE isolated checkout. Do not assume prior patches persisted. No physical actuation without explicit authorization and an isolated target.

TEST AND EVIDENCE: Retain V2's unit tests: R=10368 eps for N=4,s=.999,W=30d; cold stateless k=1,D=T_rb=T_mid=43,H_tail=43,delta=30,p_f=1 => rho=159,E=159; p_f=0 => rho=159,E=43; censored/invalid BOUND_MISSING; order statistic and Clopper-Pearson; no double charge; incremental V and dedup facts; hard gates and containment. Add lambda tests: (1) S=0 implies g=-1 and lambda decays/clamps at floor; (2) S=L*R/W implies b=1,g=0, lambda unchanged; (3) S=2*L*R/W implies b=2,g=1, lambda rises; (4) dt max 30s; (5) lambda at floor yields J=V and identical V2 decisions; (6) controlled example R=1000, lambda_s=100, candidates A(V=10,E=100) and B(V=9,E=1) gives J_A=0, J_B=8.9, so V3 picks B while V2 picks A; (7) containment bypasses price; (8) missing telemetry, clock backwards, failed write and open-to-settled transfer never silently activate price; (9) zero price when E=0; (10) no entropy, history picker or priced-worth rejection. Run Go tests and matched 64-tick replay. Report lambda saturation and missing-data reasons. Do not call replay counterfactuals observed live outcomes.
